mapper.select: SELECT p.parent_id parentId, p.office_name officeName, p.id partitionId, a.entity_table entityTable, a.meter_name meterName, a.id meterId, a.status status, r.read_date readDate, r.class_id classId, r.admin_value adminValue, r.correct_value correctValue, r.read_value readValue, r.end endTime FROM ep_partition p LEFT JOIN ep_instrument_account a ON p.id = a.partition_node LEFT JOIN ep_meter_read r ON a.id = r.meter_id WHERE (a.meter_type = #{meterType} OR a.meter_type IS NULL) AND (r.read_date >= #{startDate} and r.read_date <= #{endDate} or r.read_date is null )

SELECT a.meter_name meterName, a.partition_node partitionId, a.meter_type meterType, a.entity_table entityTable, a.id meterId, r.read_value readValue, r.id id, t.`name` meterTypeName, a.status status FROM ep_instrument_account a INNER JOIN ep_meter_read r ON a.id = r.meter_id INNER JOIN ep_energy_type t ON a.meter_type = t.id WHERE r.read_date = #{readDate} AND a.id = #{meterId}

SELECT meter_id meterId, read_time readTime, id, read_value readValue, admin_flag adminFlag FROM ( SELECT r.meter_id, r.read_time, r.id, r.read_value, r.admin_flag, row_number() over ( PARTITION BY r.meter_id ORDER BY r.read_time DESC ) AS ranking FROM ep_meter_read r INNER JOIN ep_instrument_account a ON r.meter_id = a.id WHERE a.entity_table = 1 ) t WHERE ranking <= 2

SELECT p.parent_id parentId, p.office_name officeName, p.id partitionId, a.entity_table entityTable, a.meter_name meterName, a.id meterId, a.status status FROM ep_partition p LEFT JOIN ep_instrument_account a ON p.id = a.partition_node WHERE p.del_flag = 0 and p.type = #{meterType} and (a.show_flag = 1 or a.show_flag is null)
